content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Mobile

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, secondary diploma, or other credentials—and document your hours of hands-on project work. Granite PM Academy can guide you through this verification process before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course, delivered by certified professionals. You'll attend scheduled sessions online, engage directly with your instructor, and receive real-time feedback on case studies relevant to Mobile's industrial and logistics-driven projects. All 35 required contact hours are tracked and documented for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your training, complete the official PMI PMP application and pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides a checklist of required documents and guides you through the submission portal. PMI will audit and approve your application before you can sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and recorded review sessions—to reinforce your knowledge of project management frameworks and best practices. On exam day, you'll sit for the computer-based test at an approved PMI testing center. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts before your scheduled test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Once certified, you'll enter PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, conferences, volunteer work, or published articles in your field. Renew your credential and dues before expiration to keep your PMP active and recognized by employers across the Gulf Coast region.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
